name: harness-md
description: Helps a developer and their coding agent work out and build a project's agent harness together: create one, improve one, write a design down as HARNESS.md files, or adopt the design of another project. Decisions are settled in rounds, layer by layer — environment, knowledge, feedback, gates, authority, completion, entropy — with spec-driven development skills for daily work.
